transcript: Speaker A: English bolne ki practice karo, bas roz 15 minute. June khatam hote-hote tum English bol rahe hoge. Shuru karein? Dekho, English seekhna mushkil nahi hai, mushkil hai shuru karna. Toh aaj se shuru karo. English Seekho App download karo, do hafte ka challenge lo. Roz sirf 15 minute. Pehla hafta, expert ke videos dekho. Spoken English show hai. Hindi mein samjha ke English bolna sikhate hain. Basics se start hoga - Hello, Thank you, Excuse me, yahan se. Chhote do se paanch minute ke videos, itne aasaan ki lagega ki ye toh mujhe bhi aa sakta hai. Dusra hafta, AI coach ke saath practice karo. 24 ghante available hai, subah 5 baje bhi, raat ko 12 baje bhi. Jo expert ke videos mein seekha na, woh AI coach se bol ke practice karo. Galat bologe, sudhaar degi. Pronunciation galat hai, pakad legi. Tense galat hai, bata degi. Sau baar galat bologe, sau baar sudhaar degi. Kabhi judge nahi karegi, kabhi nahi hasegi. Kabhi nahi bolegi ki itna bhi nahi aata tumhe. Aur sabse badi baat, kisi stranger se baat nahi karni hai. Kisi ajnabi ke saamne galat English bol ke sharmana nahi hai. Tum aur AI coach, bas private, safe, tumhari speed se. 14 din mein kya hoga? English perfect nahi hogi, jhoot nahi bolunga. Par itna hoga ki tum bol paoge, bina ruke, bina dare, bina sharmaye. Aur woh kaafi hai shuru karne ke liye. Jo experts ne sikhaya hai, woh AI coach se practice karo. Trial sirf ek rupaye. No bahana, sirf practice. English Seekho App download karo aaj hi. [Practice speaking English for just 15 minutes daily. By the end of June, you will be speaking English. Shall we start? Look, learning English is not difficult; starting is. So start today. Download the English Seekho App and take the two-week challenge. Just 15 minutes daily. First week, watch expert videos. It's a spoken English show. They teach English by explaining in Hindi. It starts from the basics - Hello, Thank you, Excuse me. Short 2 to 5-minute videos, so easy that you'll feel you can do it too. Second week, practice with the AI coach. Available 24 hours, even at 5 AM or 12 midnight. Practice what you learned in the expert videos with the AI coach. If you speak incorrectly, it will correct you. If pronunciation is wrong, it will catch it. If tenses are wrong, it will tell you. If you make mistakes a hundred times, it will correct you a hundred times. It will never judge or laugh at you. It will never say you don't even know this much. And the best part, you don't have to talk to a stranger. No need to feel shy speaking wrong English in front of an outsider. Just you and the AI coach, private, safe, at your own pace. What will happen in 14 days? Your English won't be perfect, I won't lie. But you will be able to speak without stopping, without fear, and without shyness. And that is enough to start. Practice what experts taught with the AI coach. Trial is just one rupee. No excuses, only practice. Download the English Seekho App today.] Speaker B: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho App download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho App.]
